triage.fix_rationale: Running npm audit fix updates the vulnerable resolved versions in package-lock.json. package.json may also need bumps, or overrides, for any direct dependency ranges that block the patched versions.
triage.hypothesis: npm audit at --audit-level=high found newly published advisories in transitive and direct dependencies (piscina critical, undici, brace-expansion, browserslist, fast-uri, js-yaml high). The lockfile pins vulnerable versions, though a fix is available for each.
